title: Abductee friend grabs a gray by the neck
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Abductee friend grabs a gray by the neck, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and she actually in one of her experiences, she actually grabbed one by the neck and squeezed it before she passed out

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, tells of a friend of his who says she has been taken by non-human beings more than once. He says that during one of these experiences she grabbed a gray, the small grey-skinned being common in these accounts, by the neck and squeezed it before she passed out. If true, it would mean the beings are physical enough to be grabbed and fought.
